label: Selected grounding source path from aligned finite throughput coverage (inference)
rule: Locate the net exporter and lift its positive-transfer path to the selected grounding cone
meaning: The no-return entry into the fixed recipient gives a net exporter upstream of its sender. By export coverage that exporter has no actual concrete ground. Positive entries follow Profile.grounds, so the same exporter is a source reached in the recipient's complete grounding cone. The ledger of finite total throughput can omit grounding edges.
